subject: Gen5 Beta1 CI V1 failed only on nonexistent focused-test selector; runtime not implicated
body: GitHub Actions run 36981087516 completed failure. Exact Gen4 baseline verification, Gen5 support checksum verification, patcher syntax, Gen5 patch application, Gen5 invariant validation, Java setup and Gradle setup all passed. Focused-test step then failed because workflow selected '*Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerTest', which does not exist. Existing regression test is Fold7CoverVisualAttemptOwnerGen3Test. No runtime commit occurred and no APK was published. Gen5 payload/patcher bytes are unchanged. A V2 root-ready package corrects only the selector plus support metadata/sentinel and passed package validation, YAML parse, support/all checksums, pure-Kotlin smoke, ZIP integrity and fresh-extract revalidation. Continue research against the principal design; do not infer a runtime defect from this CI failure.
